name: Wilhelm Gottsreich Sigismond Ormstein
original_name: ヴィルヘルム・ゴッツライヒ・ジギスモント・オルムシュタイン
source:
A young boy who came to London to visit the Great Exhibition. [spoiler]A young prince from the royal family of Bohemia with an excessively long name. He witnessed the explosion at the Great Exhibition.[/spoiler]
